newsitem.title: UK: Virgin to use Union Jack for planes - report.
newsitem.headline: Virgin to use Union Jack for planes - report.

text.p: Britain's Virgin Group is planning to incorporate the Union Jack in its airline's livery after rival British Airways Plc dropped the national flag from most of its aircraft, the Sun newspaper said.
The report said Virgin estimated it would cost no more than 100,000 stg to change its livery.

BA last week unveiled its new corporate image in a facelift combining ethnic art with Britain's national colours of red, white and blue. The decision by the former state-owned airline to drop the national flag was considered controversial.
